{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
print("Number of unique patients:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of rows:", len(trial_df))

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq entries
patient_sample_counts = trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print("Patients with multiple sample_seq:", patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count())

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that we now have one row per patient
print("After deduplication: Number of rows:", len(trial_df))"}
